Non-generals led the June 25 flow; NVDA was negative on the low day and META spike was later confirmation.
Bar recovery 0.41 was below 0.70 and 44-65% of trades were excluded at midpoint; do not promote signed flow to a calibrated execution signal.

gold_standard_sentence: The flow sequence supports visibility around the turn, not established predictive leadership. Cohort composition matters, and the failed signing gate confines the evidence to display rather than a calibrated tradable signal.
